description: Scoped least-privilege capability set for the primary application window. Grants event listener and unlistener permissions required for asynchronous P2P replication event dispatch (sync://envelope-received, background://sync-tick, background://sync-now-requested) while omitting event emit from the webview. The background://sync-now-requested event is emitted natively by the system tray 'Sync Now' menu item (WP-016b) and requires no additional webview-side capability — the existing core:event:allow-listen covers it. Does not grant broad core plugins or filesystem/shell access.
